stories.title: Building a stronger Canada through a well-managed, predictable immigration system
stories.summary: An immigration system that is well-managed, efficient and focused on our economic needs is key to building Canada strong. Every year, Canada tables an immigration levels plan outlining the targets for temporary and permanent resident admissions for the next three years. Last year and through Budget 2025, we committed to taking back control over the…

stories.title: New penalties for fraudulent and unauthorized immigration and citizenship representatives
stories.summary: The Government of Canada is committed to upholding the integrity of its immigration and citizenship systems and protecting applicants from fraud and exploitation. To help safeguard applicants from those who would take advantage of them, new penalties of up to $1.5 million are now in force for those who break the law when providing paid immigration or…

stories.title: Canada refocusing Express Entry on top talent that drives economic growth
stories.summary: October 16, 2026—Kitchener, Ontario—Building a stronger Canada means restoring confidence in a well-managed immigration system that meets our economic needs. This includes attracting and retaining skilled talent to complement the Canadian workforce and drive economic growth.

stories.title: Changes to Express Entry for high-wage occupations
stories.summary: On November 3, 2026, changes to Express Entry willintroduce points for eligible Canadian work experience or qualifying job offers in high­wage occupations, and remove labour market impact assessment (LMIA) requirements for qualifying job offers used to establish program eligibility and obtain Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) points

stories.title: Minister Metlege Diab to highlight new Productivity Mega Deduction that will help businesses invest, grow, and create jobs in Canada
stories.summary: The Honourable Lena Metlege Diab, Minister of Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship, will highlight recent government changes to Canada’s business tax system, boosting Canada’s advantage as the most competitive G7 country for new business investment. A media availability will follow.

stories.title: Canada is supporting new projects to promote Francophone immigration and strengthen Francophone minority communities
stories.summary: Collaboration is essential to addressing Canada’s workforce needs and responding to the realities facing Francophone communities. Given the challenges posed by labour shortages and the ongoing need to attract and retain talent, Canada is joining forces with its partners and reinforcing its commitment to Francophone immigration.

stories.title: Projects aimed at supporting Francophone minority communities
stories.summary: The Centre for Innovation in Francophone Immigration (CIFI) aims to integrate Francophone perspectives into immigration programs in Canada. It promotes immigration to French-speaking employers, facilitates access to programs and supports the growth of Francophone minority communities (FMCs). The CIFI supports innovative projects to reduce obstacles to…

stories.summary: The Honourable Lena Metlege Diab, Minister of Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship, will hold a press conference in St. John’s to unveil innovative projects to strengthen Francophone immigration in Newfoundland and Labrador and other Francophone minority communities outside Quebec. Minister Metlege Diab will be joined by the Honourable Lin Paddock,…

stories.title: New EMN-OECD joint inform on drivers and policies to retain global talent
stories.summary: The latest EMN and OECD joint inform explores how EMN Member and Observer Countries approach the retention of global talent, covering the factors that support or hinder retention and the policies and practices introduced to support longer-term stay. Read more.
stories.source: 欧盟委员会移民与内政总司

stories.title: EMN Ireland Presidency Conference: Future-proofing Europe’s labour migration policy
stories.summary: The EMN Ireland Presidency Conference, ‘Future-proofing Europe’s labour migration policy: New approaches to managing labour immigration amidst a changing labour and skills landscape’, will take place in Dublin on 19 and 20 November 2026.
stories.source: 欧盟委员会移民与内政总司

stories.title: EU and Nigeria sign readmission agreement furthering cooperation on migration and security
stories.summary: On 10 November, the EU and the Federal Republic of Nigeria signed a readmission agreement, marking an important step in their partnership on migration and security. Commissioner Brunner represented the EU at the signing ceremony, underlining that this is part of a wider partnership on migration.
stories.source: 欧盟委员会移民与内政总司

stories.title: Commission launches second Annual Migration Management Cycle
stories.summary: On 6 November, the Commission launched the second Annual Migration Management Cycle, providing a comprehensive overview of migration trends and risks in the EU over the previous year, identifying Member States facing migratory pressure, and proposing the establishment of the second Solidarity Pool.
stories.source: 欧盟委员会移民与内政总司

stories.title: Investigations supported by Europol expose international migrant smuggling networks
stories.summary: Migrant smuggling poses a major security threat to the EU and the Schengen Area. Europol plays a key role in combating this crime and helping national authorities to dismantle smuggling networks. It supports investigations, facilitates information and provides on-site operational support.
stories.source: 欧盟委员会移民与内政总司

stories.title: New information alert in the Schengen Information System to improve security
stories.summary: The Schengen Information System has enhanced capabilities to fight terrorism and serious organised crime. A new information alert will make information shared by non-EU countries and international organisations on suspected terrorists and serious criminals available across the EU in real time.
stories.source: 欧盟委员会移民与内政总司

stories.title: Commission provides additional EU funding to strengthen border security
stories.summary: The European Commission is providing an additional EUR 130 million under the Border Management and Visa Instrument to support drone and counter-drone measures that strengthen security at the EU external borders.
stories.source: 欧盟委员会移民与内政总司

stories.title: Staying the course on migration reform
stories.summary: On 29 September, the Commission proposed a 5-point plan to prevent, anticipate and respond to sudden mass illegal arrivals. The Plan will strengthen the resilience and security of EU external borders. Member States, JHA agencies and the Commission will now work together to deliver on these actions.
stories.source: 欧盟委员会移民与内政总司
